name: Inventory Master
notes: v1.0.6: Fixed Hotbar Row Swap [V] and Smart Item Split (Shift/Ctrl+RightClick) silently placing items into hidden, inactive backpack slots whenever the player had no backpack equipped (or a smaller-tier backpack) - the item wasn't actually lost, but it vanished from view with no visible destination. Both features now correctly skip inactive backpack slots, matching how the game's own inventory logic already does. Also includes the v1.0.5 diagnostic logging.
